notes: Both comparison months are June (30 days each), so monthly amounts compare directly as daily rates. Stocks are end-month levels on national territory.
Product inventories are grouped differently from output: middle distillates include gas/diesel oil, jet kerosene and other kerosene.
The publication includes country estimates; see PDF page 5.
Product stock rows are subsets of All products, not additive alongside that total.
No common barrel conversion factor has been applied.
June 2025 and June 2026 both come from the September 2026 edition (year-earlier columns), so no cross-edition revision gap exists.
Flows compare mean daily output: monthly thousand tonnes divided by 30 days for each June.
Not seasonally adjusted. The comparison does not isolate the effect of the war.

chokepoints.scope: Global route traffic: crude oil and petroleum liquids; not limited to OECD destinations. Routes overlap and cannot be added.
